How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here’s how to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in a beautiful Abbott Lyon presentation box or envelope. Handle it gently to avoid tangling or scratching.
Wear It Last: When getting ready, put your jewellery on after applying cosmetics, perfumes, or lotions to keep it looking pristine.
Everyday Use: If your piece is stainless steel, it’s water and sweat-resistant, so it can handle splashes or light exposure. For other materials, avoid water to maintain its shine.
Storage: When not wearing it, store your jewellery in its original box or a soft pouch to protect it from scratches.
Enjoy showing off your stunning new piece! Let me know if you need more tips. 🧡
